d:
I finally got tired of waiting, especially when over 90% of this has already been translated for months now. Besides the first page and the last 13 pages which are machine translated (RIP @Messymark), this is almost entirely compiled from several different translators over various works, so I marked it as human translated. Some works were translated by more than one translator, and I had to choose one, but the quality of translation didn't really seem to vary that much either way (apart from the handful of mtl pages of course). Thank you to all the translators that contributed to this compilation.
